name: verification-python-9
description: Purposive, resource-constrained Python scientific-repair subset: 9 tasks from 9 repositories/domains, selected from the existing main-12 development panel.
selection_basis: Homogeneous Python source-patch execution, avoiding an unvalidated native rebuild path.
No restricted-license opt-in, matching the parent panel.
At most one task per repository; among same-commit DESC tasks retain the faster historical baseline task.
Exclude 033 by declared compute constraint, including its unusually expensive repeated verifier runs.
Retain all remaining eligible parent-panel tasks, including historical all-fail and all-pass tasks.

033.reason: Explicit user resource constraint; both historical baseline agents hit ~90 min, followed by ~10-13.5 min verifier runs. Expensive repeated evaluation is outside this study scope.

004.reason: C++/bedtools2 needs a clean rebuild after each source patch. The current cross evaluator applies source patches and runs Python checks without an explicit rebuild. Native-language evaluation is outside the homogeneous Python main study; may be reported separately after build validation.

014.reason: Same DESC repository and base commit as 008. Retain one task per repository to reduce correlated sampling; retain 008, with lower historical median baseline wall time. All three 014 baseline agent executions hit 90 min. Reward was not a tie-breaking input.

disclosure.scope: Small exploratory multi-domain Python subset; no estimate of full 119-task benchmark accuracy.
disclosure.task_017: Used to debug the paired verification protocol. Report main-nine results both with and without 017 as a declared sensitivity analysis; neither is an unseen-task holdout.
disclosure.models: Keep Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.8 runs separate; model and harness differences confound cross-project comparisons.

evaluation_rules: Apply the same selected IDs to all compared arms.
Freeze protocol and model/CLI versions before new evaluation runs.
Count timeouts, invalid suites and abstentions explicitly; do not remove tasks after observing outcomes.
Separate fixed historical-pool selection diagnostics from fresh equal-total-budget end-to-end comparisons.
Report macro task accuracy, pool oracle ceiling, false accepts/rejects, coverage and full inference cost.
